It is submitted that both the parties state that the petitioners and Respondent No.2 have no other claims of whatsoever nature against each other past, present or further.

(i) Petition is disposed of in terms of the Joint Memo dated 10.06.2025.

(ii) The entire proceedings arising out of FIR dated 25.01.2024 in Crime No.48/2024 registered by the 1st respondent - Police, for offences punishable under Section 498-A of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the D.P.Act, pending on the file of XLVI ACJM, Bangalore, insofar as the petitioners are concerned are hereby quashed.
